meta.name: Hastra epoch timing - temporary 75 minute reduction
meta.description: Stage 1 ONLY: queue 600300 seconds (7 days minus 75 minutes) during epoch 3, before the next epoch advance. Applies at that advance and governs the following interval. After activation, use a SEPARATE later transaction to queue 603900 seconds. Do not combine both duration changes before an epoch advance. Recheck epoch and queued duration before signing. Workflow permissions are not included.
